facts.value: Kraton Corporation (NYSE: KRA), Houston, Texas; polymer and chemical segments
DL Chemical Co., Ltd. (“Parent”), Seoul, South Korea, a subsidiary of DL Holdings Co., Ltd., through DLC US Holdings, Inc. and DLC US, Inc.

$46.50 per share in cash, without interest; about $2.5 billion of total funds (including refinancing of Kraton debt), from up to $1.75 billion of committed debt financing (Goldman Sachs Bank USA) and Parent's cash; no financing condition

None reported for the whole company. From December 2020 Kraton pursued a corporate development plan: buying or combining with the polymer businesses of Parties A and B (both declined) and selling its CST business (Parties C, D, E, F, G approached); the CST track carried into process 1 as round 0 (#2, #3, #4, #7). Parent had bought Kraton's Cariflex business in March 2020.
Met (process 1): 11 parties (10 by late June 2021 — 6 strategic, 4 financial — plus 1 financial party after 07/06/2021)
Yes (also segment bids: Parties C and G for portions of the CST business, Party K for the chemical segment, Party A's alternative for the polymer segment)

facts.field: Currency and units of bid prices
facts.value: US dollars per share for whole-company bids; segment bids in total US dollars, enterprise value or multiples of segment EBITDA (mixed bases; see Q1). Party A's last two bids add an earnout to the per-share price.

After a corporate development plan to buy polymer businesses and sell the CST business stalled, Kraton's board decided on 05/20/2021 to explore a sale of the whole company. J.P. Morgan contacted 14 listed parties and received one inbound inquiry; 10 signed confidentiality agreements, and one more financial party signed after a 07/06 Reuters leak. Four indications arrived by early July (Party A $42–45, H $41–43, Parent $41, I $40), and after a request for higher values the board advanced A, H and Parent on 07/20, dropping I and late bidder J. H withdrew on 08/20; in the final round Parent bid $46.00 and then, at the board's request, $46.50 best and final, while Party A bid $40.50 and then $42.00 and $44.00 with chemical-segment earnouts. Segment offers from Parties C, G and K were weighed as a sum-of-the-parts alternative and rejected, and Kraton signed with Parent on 09/27/2021 at $46.50 in cash.
